item.name: read a log stream's trace spans

request.description:
Read OTEL trace spans for a log stream.

Returns the flat list of spans recorded by the runner for the job execution
(or executions) associated with this log stream, ordered by start timestamp
ASC. The frontend assembles the tree from `parent_span_id`.

item.name: get a runner connection satus based on heartbeat

request.description:
# get runner connect status

The connected status is based on runner heartbeat:

if no heart beat found — false
if heart beat > 15 seconds ago — false, hb timestamp
if the heart beat < 15 seconds ago — true

item.name: Prune old tokens for a runner

request.description:
Prune old tokens for a specific runner by invalidating all tokens except the most recent one.

This is useful for cleaning up old tokens without disrupting the currently running runner.
The latest token (by creation time) is preserved, ensuring the active runner continues to function.

Returns the count of invalidated tokens for the specified runner.
